title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 14: Amaziah king of Judah, the parable of the thistle and the cedar, the battle at Beth Shemesh and the reign of Jeroboam son of Joash.

questions.text: How old was Amaziah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Once the kingdom was established in his hand, whom did Amaziah kill?
questions.explanation: As soon as the kingdom was established, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father.

answers.text: His servants who had slain his father
The priests of Baal in Jerusalem
All the children of the murderers
The elders of Samaria who opposed him

questions.text: Why did Amaziah not put the children of the murderers to death?
questions.explanation: He acted according to the book of the law of Moses, which says the children shall not be put to death for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

answers.text: A prophet had asked him to spare their lives
The children had fled to Lachish before him
The people of Judah begged him to spare them
The law of Moses says every man shall die for his own sin

questions.text: What name did Amaziah give to Sela after he took it by war?
questions.explanation: He took Sela by war and called its name Joktheel.

questions.text: In Jehoash's parable, what trampled down the thistle?
questions.explanation: A wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

answers.text: The cedar that was in Lebanon
A strong east wind from the desert
A wild animal that was in Lebanon
An army that came up from Samaria

questions.text: Where did Jehoash king of Israel and Amaziah king of Judah meet face to face in battle?
questions.explanation: They looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

questions.text: What did Jehoash do to the wall of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

answers.text: He broke it down from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate
He rebuilt it with cedar wood from Lebanon
He set all of its gates on fire with torches
He made it higher with stones from Samaria

questions.text: To which city did Amaziah flee when a conspiracy was made against him in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

questions.text: Which city did Azariah build and restore to Judah?
questions.explanation: Azariah built Elath and restored it to Judah.

questions.text: Through which prophet had Yahweh spoken the word fulfilled when Jeroboam restored the border of Israel?
questions.explanation: Jeroboam restored the border according to Yahweh's word spoken by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.
